name: Delaware Basin (Permian) onshore production, monthly per facility

region.name: Delaware Basin (Permian)
region.reconcileScope: the Delaware Basin counties of RRC district 08, part of Texas

sources.name: Texas Railroad Commission Production Data Query dump, RRC districts 08, 8A, 7C: Brewster, Culberson, El Paso, Hudspeth, Jeff Davis, Loving, Pecos, Presidio, Reeves, Ward, Winkler counties (Delaware Basin); well locations from the RRC well layers by county
sources.datum: NAD83 (RRC’s LAT83 / LONG83 columns in the well layers)
sources.transform: none — RRC publishes NAD83 beside the NAD27 originals; an oil lease is drawn at the centroid of its wells, a gas well at its own surface location
sources.license: Public record of the Railroad Commission of Texas; RRC site policies grant permission for noncommercial use, and the founder decided on 2026-09-28 to show it on the hosted site (docs/LICENCES.md)
sources.finality: a monthly snapshot: RRC revises earlier months as corrected reports arrive, so each dump can change past months; --refresh reads the newest dump
sources.precision: well coordinates rounded to six decimals
sources.reporterRule: oil leases and gas wells with a production report filed for the month (PROD_REPORT_FILED_FLAG Y)

completeness.rule: newest month whose count of facilities that filed is at least the threshold share of the median over the preceding lookback of months, that median being at least the floor share of the median over the lookback before it
completeness.reporterRule: oil leases and gas wells with a production report filed for the month (PROD_REPORT_FILED_FLAG Y)

reconciliation.note: State filings are gross gas at the wellhead as reported by operators; EIA gross withdrawals include estimates for wells the state file omits (confidential wells, late filers), marketed production excludes gas flared, vented and used for repressuring. Region totals exclude nothing the files carry.
